prerequisites: Basic knowledge of chemistry and physics, B1 level.

learning_outcomes.text: Students are expected to have insight into the main environmental problems and their interrelationships. The emphasis is on industrial and technological aspects.
Techniques to prevent or remediate environmental problems are also covered.
Describe the evolution of general policy regarding environmental issues.
Describe pollutants, their formation, sources, properties, and effects for air and water pollution and waste problems.
Discuss a number of methods for controlling environmental pollution, both preventively and curatively.
Propose solutions for controlling environmental pollution: air purification, water pollution, waste problems.

syllabus_topics: Technologies for the treatment of water, air and waste materials
assessment_rules: The assessment is a written exam with open questions. A calculator is allowed as study material.
bibliography: Powerpoint presentation of the lessons, on Toledo
